# docs-api

Published **API reference** site for Notification Hub (Swagger UI + OpenAPI).
Deployed by CI from [notification-hub-service](https://github.com/sophias-hub/notification-hub-service).

**Don't maintain a changelog in this repository.** It's a publish target. Use build provenance on the site for freshness.

Product history: [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/sophias-hub/notification-hub-service/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md) (after merge to `main`) · [Releases](https://github.com/sophias-hub/notification-hub-service/releases)

Live site: https://sophias-hub.github.io/docs-api/
